finding_summary.headline: The only root to fail: the flow adaptation aborted mid-run and two objectives never finished
finding_summary.insights: The failure is not in the idea but in adapting the flow while a session is live. Re-encoding every observation after each adaptation is what makes the latent geometry stay useful, and it is also what puts a failure-prone training step inside the oracle loop, where an abort costs the remaining budget on that objective. The partial results that did land are suggestive, with 0.652 on drd2_docking from only 140 calls, so the approach is not obviously weak. The molecules also show a distinct problem: perturbing token blocks in a SELFIES-based latent produces boron, phosphorus and cumulated-double-bond structures at very high rates. A repair should move adaptation to a batch boundary with a guarded fallback before this lineage is judged on score.

molecular.headline: Boron, phosphorus and cumulated double bonds: latent perturbation decodes to chemistry that does not exist
molecular.overall_character: This is the most chemically implausible output in the round. Cumulated double bonds, essentially absent from every other root, appear in 42 percent of proposals on one objective and 95 percent on another. Boron appears as a terminal double-bonded atom, phosphorus appears as cationic chains, and charged species reach 88 percent on one objective. Aromatic content runs 31 to 66 percent, and one proposal reaches 239 characters. The exact-inverse property the method depends on is working correctly; the problem is that the latent neighbourhood being searched decodes to sequences that are valid SELFIES and impossible molecules.

transferable_gaps.generator_implication: The token vocabulary treats successive double bonds as an ordinary continuation, so a small move in latent space can insert one anywhere. Penalising or removing those tokens from the perturbable set would cost nothing the search actually needs.

method_name: NF-BO: invertible sequence-flow search with token-adaptive latent proposals
method_thesis: Use NF-BO's SeqFlow mapping, exact left-inverse decoding, and token-adaptive trust-region search. Train a compact SELFIES flow on the permitted unlabeled corpus. Within each fresh objective session, adapt it using highly scored task-local sequences, re-encode all observations after updates, and fit a latent-space GP. Generate new latent proposals around scored observations by perturbing token blocks according to their estimated pointwise mutual information with the decoded sequence. Thompson sampling selects proposals for inverse-flow decoding. These mechanisms follow [NF-BO, Sections 4 and 5.3](https://arxiv.org/html/2504.14889v1). Regenerate as needed to fill the evaluator-announced batch with distinct canonical molecules; no corpus molecules are ranked or retrieved. The hypothesis is that score-directed local search around exactly reconstructable observations finds improving structures efficiently enough to raise the mean of the five independent final Top-1 scores. Exact reconstruction alone is not the objective. Useful flow training and surrogate prediction under the permitted preparation and feedback remain empirical prerequisites.

Always emit exactly the protocol-announced batch size; no fixed candidate library or alternate graph/string mutation fallback is permitted. Write structured stderr records sufficient to reconstruct every declared observable, including model versions and hashes, adaptation membership, reconstruction failures, center identities and scores, token importance and perturbation masks, trust-region scales, candidate latent provenance, posterior values and selection ranks, generated canonical identities, rejection counters, and prospective prediction-to-observation joins.

The benchmark provides few scored starting molecules and short task-local feedback, so a useful latent optimizer must preserve the identity and labels of observed structures while producing novel nearby molecules that its posterior can distinguish. The supplied results for other paradigms do not establish flow reconstruction, token importance, or latent predictive usefulness. The bound proposal tests these prerequisites before attributing any final Top-1 benefit to local inverse-flow search.

Task-local high-score adaptation, complete fresh reencoding before every executed GP fit, PMI-preferential whole-block exploration, correlated posterior selection, and inverse-flow canonical novelty are supported through each task's recorded trajectory. finding_summary.headline: The only root to fail: the flow adaptation aborted mid-run and two objectives never finished
finding_summary.insights: The failure is not in the idea but in adapting the flow while a session is live. Re-encoding every observation after each adaptation is what makes the latent geometry stay useful, and it is also what puts a failure-prone training step inside the oracle loop, where an abort costs the remaining budget on that objective. The partial results that did land are suggestive, with 0.652 on drd2_docking from only 140 calls, so the approach is not obviously weak. The molecules also show a distinct problem: perturbing token blocks in a SELFIES-based latent produces boron, phosphorus and cumulated-double-bond structures at very high rates. A repair should move adaptation to a batch boundary with a guarded fallback before this lineage is judged on score.

finding_summary.headline: The only root to fail: the flow adaptation aborted mid-run and two objectives never finished
finding_summary.insights: The failure is not in the idea but in adapting the flow while a session is live. Re-encoding every observation after each adaptation is what makes the latent geometry stay useful, and it is also what puts a failure-prone training step inside the oracle loop, where an abort costs the remaining budget on that objective. The partial results that did land are suggestive, with 0.652 on drd2_docking from only 140 calls, so the approach is not obviously weak. The molecules also show a distinct problem: perturbing token blocks in a SELFIES-based latent produces boron, phosphorus and cumulated-double-bond structures at very high rates. A repair should move adaptation to a batch boundary with a guarded fallback before this lineage is judged on score.
finding_summary.results: The node is recorded buggy with no macro score, and its mechanism is refuted. Three objectives completed their full 290 proposals, but drd2_docking stopped at 140 accepted molecules and median_2 at 230, in both cases when a flow adaptation aborted. Of 129 adaptation attempts only 127 completed. The components that did run checked out: corpus pretraining moved held-out token loss from 15.283 to -3.877, exact left-inverse decoding held with a maximum error of 7.7e-07 at the selected checkpoint, all 840 pointwise mutual information estimates were nondegenerate, and every one of the 124 completed batches emitted exactly the announced ten valid novel molecules.

molecular_assessment.headline: Boron, phosphorus and cumulated double bonds: latent perturbation decodes to chemistry that does not exist
molecular_assessment.overall_character: This is the most chemically implausible output in the round. Cumulated double bonds, essentially absent from every other root, appear in 42 percent of proposals on one objective and 95 percent on another. Boron appears as a terminal double-bonded atom, phosphorus appears as cationic chains, and charged species reach 88 percent on one objective. Aromatic content runs 31 to 66 percent, and one proposal reaches 239 characters. The exact-inverse property the method depends on is working correctly; the problem is that the latent neighbourhood being searched decodes to sequences that are valid SELFIES and impossible molecules.

possible_failure_causes: Observed failure: two after-adaptation checks change an accepted observation's padded token sequence. The preregistered falsifier expressly includes exact token equality, so unchanged canonical molecules do not rescue the intended left-inverse invariant. The raised exception is the direct cause of the two incomplete objective runs.

Supported hypothesis, not isolated causality: task adaptation amplifies finite-precision recurrent inverse error. Forward evaluation runs the GRU over the full sequence, while inversion feeds reconstructed values recurrently one position at a time (optimize.py:116-132). On the failed tasks maximum inverse error grows from 5.364418029785156e-07 initially to about 0.30 before the final update and about 0.405 afterward, despite unchanged minimum embedding separation. Bounded individual affine scales do not establish numerically stable composition. Logs do not identify the mismatched token position, so padding drift versus a chemically redundant token change remains unresolved.

The terminal reconstruction assertion precedes adaptation-receipt emission and reencoding. Hence the two failed updates have no logged member/loss/displacement receipt, limiting attribution of the exact update that crossed the reconstruction threshold; subsequent GP selection did not execute on a stale representation.

Separate predictive limitation: nominal 95% intervals cover only 444/1240 subsequently accepted scores, with predominantly negative standardized residual means. This is evidence of poorly calibrated optimistic predictions in the tested local proposal distribution, not the reason for refuting acquisition execution.

Separate novelty bottleneck: 56423/57909 examined decodes reproduce the selected center and require 197 refill groups. Every emitted batch still fills correctly; these observations do not establish neighborhood exhaustion or an alternate proposal fallback.

applicability_conditions: Applies to independent scalar molecular maximization objectives when initial and subsequently accepted structures admit lossless SELFIES encoding in the prepared representation.
The permitted corpus must support useful flow fitting within the supplied preparation resources, and its learned coordinates must admit enough canonical novelty under local token-block perturbations.

A latent GP fitted from the small task-local observation history must have useful predictive structure for Thompson selection to improve objective values; injectivity alone supplies no such guarantee.
Flow parameter updates preserve the invertible architecture and distinct token embeddings, and every GP observation is re-encoded after each representation change.
Prepared weights and vocabulary are shared unlabeled state; all scored examples, online flow updates, posterior state, trust regions and proposal histories restart for each objective.

This root follows the method identity with compact training and inference appropriate to the frozen profile. The paper's larger initialization and feedback settings do not establish transfer to this benchmark, and screening-seed evidence cannot establish multi-seed reliability.
The conditional BARK direction from the proposal is reserved for a later experiment; it requires chronological evidence of root posterior overconfidence and is not part of this root.

approach.method_basis: NF-BO does Bayesian optimization in a latent space that is exactly invertible. A normalizing flow maps molecular sequences to continuous latents and back with no reconstruction error, so a point chosen in latent space decodes to a definite molecule rather than an approximation. A Gaussian process is fitted over the scored latents, Thompson sampling picks promising directions, and proposals are made by perturbing selected token blocks within a trust region before decoding back through the inverse flow.
approach.novelty: This root commits to choosing which token blocks to perturb by an estimated sequence-level pointwise mutual information rather than uniformly, so the perturbation concentrates on positions the flow considers informative. It also adapts the flow to high-scoring task-local sequences mid-session and re-encodes every observation after each adaptation, which keeps the latent geometry aligned with the current objective instead of frozen at corpus statistics.

research_intent.falsifier: The intended root mechanism is refuted if the explicit left inverse changes an encoded observed sequence or its canonical molecule, flow adaptation uses non-task-local labels, the GP consumes stale encodings after an update, token masks ignore the computed PMI probabilities or yield no importance preference despite nondegenerate estimates, posterior uncertainty does not participate in selection, or emitted structures come from a corpus pool or a proposal mechanism other than the declared inverse-flow trust regions. Failure to lower the fixed heldout flow NLL or persistent equal-PMI estimates across all centers refutes the corresponding learned-prior or token-adaptation prerequisite. Inability to fill valid novel batches through this method refutes its generative viability. Missing provenance or measurements makes activation inconclusive. Once the declared transformations, adaptations and acquisitions activate, poor predictive coverage or lack of final Top-1 improvement is negative predictive/score evidence, not grounds to relabel execution as successful improvement or as an implementation failure.

research_intent.mechanism: Search around scored task-local molecules in an injective SELFIES SeqFlow latent space, adapt the flow to high-scoring observations, and use a latent GP with Thompson sampling to select fresh trust-region proposals whose perturbed token blocks are chosen from estimated sequence-level PMI before exact inverse-flow decoding.
research_intent.observed_bottleneck: This root has no Parent or evaluated NF-BO node. The benchmark provides few scored starting molecules and short task-local feedback, so a useful latent optimizer must preserve the identity and labels of observed structures while producing novel nearby molecules that its posterior can distinguish. The supplied results for other paradigms do not establish flow reconstruction, token importance, or latent predictive usefulness. The bound proposal tests these prerequisites before attributing any final Top-1 benefit to local inverse-flow search.
